Federal Parliament
Session, 2082
Joint Meeting
Meeting Number-1
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
2082 Chaitra 27, Friday
3:00 PM
Address by the Right Honourable President
The Right Honourable President Ram Chandra Poudel will address the joint meeting of both houses of the Federal Parliament.
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The daily business schedule for the joint meeting of the Federal Parliament of Nepal was announced. The meeting was scheduled for 3:00 PM on Friday, Chaitra 27, 2082.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The Right Honourable President Ram Chandra Poudel addressed the joint meeting of both houses of the Federal Parliament.

sections.name: Adjournment
sections.summary_en: The Secretary-General, Padma Prasad Pandey, announced the conclusion of the meeting.
